title: Thyroid Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT spanning anaplastic and medullary thyroid carcinoma (which carry different protocol diseaseId tags, hence matchDisease:false and per-node reference scoping). Captures subtype and, for anaplastic disease, BRAF V600E status, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Differentiated (papillary/follicular) thyroid cancer is managed distinctly and is not covered here. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Thyroid Carcinoma; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thyroid Carcinoma. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Subtype
nodes.title: Thyroid cancer subtype
nodes.description: Anaplastic and medullary thyroid carcinoma follow distinct, biomarker-directed systemic pathways.

nodes.name: Anaplastic - BRAF status
nodes.title: Anaplastic: BRAF V600E status
nodes.description: A BRAF V600E mutation enables BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy in anaplastic thyroid carcinoma. BRAF wild-type anaplastic disease is managed with clinical-trial / multidisciplinary options not modeled here.

nodes.name: Anaplastic BRAF-mutant
nodes.title: Anaplastic, BRAF V600E: BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy
nodes.description: BRAF V600E-mutant anaplastic thyroid carcinoma - dabrafenib plus trametinib. Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.name: Medullary - RET status
nodes.title: Medullary: RET alteration status
nodes.description: Selpercatinib is a selective RET inhibitor indicated for RET-altered medullary thyroid carcinoma. RET wild-type medullary disease is managed with multikinase inhibitors / clinical-trial options not modeled here.

nodes.name: Medullary
nodes.title: Medullary: RET-directed therapy
nodes.description: Advanced medullary thyroid carcinoma - a selective RET inhibitor (selpercatinib) for RET-altered disease. Physician selects.
